decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted drawings, within 1 month of this approval, waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the permitted number of occupiers shall have been provided on site. The development shall not be occupied until waste storage and recycling facilities have been fully provided on site.General waste storage shall be provided in the form of a commercial HMO container/containers. There is a weekly hire charge to these containers which will need to be paid and can be ordered through the Council's Commercial Waste team. Recycling facilities shall be provided in accordance with Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024), which includes a waste capacity calculator for weekly collection, which shall be used to establish the type and quantity of recycling bins required.Such facilities are to be retained thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.

The HMO hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than 8 residents at any one time, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not compromise standards of accommodation and does not adversely affect the residential amenities of neighbouring properties.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Velo-store specification,Notice Under Article 12 - Request for Waiver of Planning Application Requirement,Design and Access Statement Planning Statement,Traffic Survey,Highway Safety Impact Form,SuDS Pro-Forma,ELIRANDA-07-PL01,ELIRANDA-07-PL02,ELIRANDA-07-PL03,Location Plan.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted drawings, within 1 month of the date of this approval, 8 long stay cycle parking spaces to satisfy the permitted number of occupiers on site shall have been fully provided. The development shall not be occupied until required cycle parking facilities have been fully provided on site.The dedicated cycle store(s) providing 8 long stay parking spaces shall fulfil the following:Siting: Located in a secure, covered area within the building or in a dedicated cycle store.Access: The cycle store(s) shall be step free accessible with aisles at least 1.5 meters wide to allow easy manoeuvring. Access to reach the store shall involve no more than 2 doors or gates (excluding the store door).Security: Located with natural surveillance and good lighting, the cycles store shall be secured with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob to provide greater security.Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.
description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to a Class Sui Generis (HMO - house in multiple occupation) with associated amenity, cycle and refuse storage (RETROSPECTIVE).
